explanation: The search summaries add a nominal tier beneath the FDR call: summarize takes a raw-p accessor and lists FDR survivors by q, then tracks with p < 0.05 that fail FDR by p (falling back to the lowest p when neither exists). The gene rows and the pathway portal show that tier, and the portal table gains a Call column. Its TierLabel (FDR < 0.05, p < 0.05 only or n.s.) now lives in portalCards so the pathway report renders the same words. Significant counts, directions and loadConditionPathways still follow the FDR call only.
